<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== NAVMESH TRUTH CENSUS - BOTH MAPS (Meta AI, held to the brief Tyree carried her, named the Epic-verified anchors: runtime navmesh requires Runtime Generation = Dynamic on the RecastNavMesh and a NavMeshBoundsVolume covering the walkable area, otherwise the red NAVMESH NEEDS TO BE REBUILT text persists even with runtime generation enabled in config. Job 320 set the NavigationSystemV1 keys in DefaultEngine.ini; this job verifies the OTHER half inside the maps themselves: the RecastNavMesh actors runtime generation value and the NavMeshBoundsVolumes bounds, in VEILDistrict and OMNIWorld. It also carries the capture lesson of jobs 321/322, whose commandlet prints never reached their results: the Python writes its findings to a text file itself, and PowerShell reads that file - no console redirect ambiguity. READ-ONLY: nothing edited.) ==='
foreach ($g in @(@('VEIL','D:\VEIL','VEILDistrict'), @('OMNI','D:\OMNI-UE','OMNIWorld'))) {
  $name = $g[0]; $proj = $g[1]; $mapname = $g[2]
  "##### $name #####" | Write-Output
  $umap = Get-ChildItem "$proj\Content" -Recurse -Filter "$mapname.umap" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $umap) { Write-Output "MAP NOT FOUND: $mapname"; continue }
  $rel = $umap.FullName.Substring(("$proj\Content").Length).Replace('\','/'); $gpath = '/Game' + $rel.Replace('.umap','')
  Set-Content "$proj\Saved\phi_mappath.txt" -Value $gpath -Encoding ASCII
  $py = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
  $py = $py.Replace('MAPPATHFILE', "'$proj\Saved\phi_mappath.txt'").Replace('OUTFILE', "'$proj\Saved\phi_nav_census_out.txt'")
  Set-Content "$proj\Saved\phi_nav_census.py" -Value $py -Encoding UTF8
  Remove-Item "$proj\Saved\phi_nav_census_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
  $uproj = Get-ChildItem $proj -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
  & $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$proj\Saved\phi_nav_census.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$proj\Saved\navcensus326.log"
  if (Test-Path "$proj\Saved\phi_nav_census_out.txt") { Get-Content "$proj\Saved\phi_nav_census_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO CENSUS OUTPUT FILE - commandlet log tail:'; Get-Content "$proj\Saved\navcensus326.log" -Tail 12 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Write-Output }
  '--- DefaultEngine.ini nav readback ---' | Write-Output
  Select-String -Path "$proj\Config\DefaultEngine.ini" -Pattern 'NavigationSystem|RuntimeGeneration|AutoCreate' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
}
Write-Output 'NAV TRUTH CENSUS DONE'
```
